column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: cleat#1702s three split tests each run one arm per dialect, so the mysql and mssql arms skip in this PostgreSQL-only job -- two each, six in total, while the POSTGRES arm RUNS. That last part is the reason these are safe as skips: the property they pin (disabled_at does not arm a deletion, gc_eligible does not disable, and both move together) is asserted on postgres in every job that runs ./engine/ at all, and on each other dialect in the job that provisions it. Measured with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset: 6 skips, 3 passes, 0 failures.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same three tests, same six arms, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... too. See the test-go/engine line above.
